ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a topographic profile near 40°N. Horizontally from left to right, it is marked with about 100°E, 110°E, and 120°E, and longitude increases toward the right; the right end is labeled "ocean". Wind-direction arrows are drawn on the profile, among which one arrow points to the right, that is, toward the east and the ocean side. Reasoning: The question asks about the wind direction of the "wind toward the right" when it is prevailing. Toward the right means that the horizontal component of this wind on the profile points toward the east or the ocean side. In northern China near 40°N, when wind blows outward from the inland high-pressure area toward the ocean side, it mainly corresponds to the East Asian winter monsoon; the winter monsoon usually comes from the north or northwest. Wind direction is named according to the direction it comes from, so this wind is a northerly wind.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the schematic diagram of a topographic profile near 40°N.

<image1>

When the wind toward the right in the figure is prevailing, what is the wind direction?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：剖面横向标有100°E、110°E、120°E，右端是海洋，图中有一个向右的风箭头。再读题：问“向右的风”盛行时的风向。把向右理解为该风在剖面上的水平分量指向东部/海洋一侧；在40°N中国北方，这对应冬季风从内陆高压区向外吹出。结合东亚冬季风来自北方或西北方，按风向以来源方向命名，得出“偏北风”。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是40°N附近的地形剖面，横向从左到右标有约100°E、110°E、120°E，经度向右增大；右端标注为“海洋”。剖面上画有风向箭头，其中有一个箭头指向右侧，即指向东部、海洋一侧。
推理：题问“向右的风”在盛行时的风向。向右表示该风在剖面上的水平分量指向东部或海洋一侧。40°N附近的中国北方，风从内陆高压区向外、向海洋一侧吹出时，主要对应东亚冬季风；冬季风通常来自北方或西北方。风向按来向命名，因此该风为偏北风。

Wind direction is named according to the direction it comes from, so this wind is a northerly wind.
